messages:
sanjay: Quick check — Atlas Compute told procurement they can ship bare-metal racks to ap-southeast1 in ~4-6 weeks for 8x A100 80GB per rack. Can eng-infra confirm if we have quota/region issues or known delays? Need this for search-ops ML infra. Cost center: RD-PLAT-3, tentative PO: PO-8742. Any objections to APAC bare-metal placement? :airplane:

mira: Do we have any reserved racks in APAC already? I thought Dedicated has a few nodes but not bare-metal. pinging @evan for quota check.

evans: I can run quota check later today. Quick tool: `gcloud compute regions describe ap-southeast1 --format='json(quotas)' | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'` — will post results.

lina: Is NVLink required for the workload? If yes we need DGX-style configs, vendor might need to confirm headroom.

ops-bot: Auto: purchase-request PO-8742 created by @sanjay. Status: pending finance approval.

vendor-atlas: Atlas support here — we have A100 80GB units available for APAC rack builds. Current lead time: 28-35 days after PO + deposit. NVLink configs add ~5 business days for assembly. We need ship-to details and confirmed PO. Vendor portal: https://vendor.atlas/portal/orders/submit

karen-finance: Finance: we can approve but need SOW + net30 vs net15? Also attach vendor W-9 for records. Who owns the delivery address? @sanjay

sanjay: Delivery to Redwood Inference APAC PO Box in SG (I'll DM the full address). We can do net30. Is there a way to stage with Dedicated while hardware ships? Want to avoid app downtime.

evans: We can provision Dedicated capacity temporarily in ap-southeast1 — capacity available but quota for GPUs rn is 64 GPUs in region (used 18). If we need 64 more, open ticket with cloud support + request region quota bump. I'll open the ticket and link it here.

evans: Opening support ticket: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project redwood-inference | tee ticket-1345.txt` — contact to request 64->128 GPU quota in ap-southeast1. CC'ing alex-cloud.

mira: :thumbsup: if vendor ETA stands. Also check on shipping customs — SG import can add 3-7 days, FYI.

vendor-atlas: We can pre-stage components in our SG warehouse to shave ~4 days if customs clears. Need PO + contact.

lina: On NVLink: recommend to avoid unless model parallelism needs it. For initial rollout, normal PCIe-connected A100 racks are fine.

karen-finance: Confirming vendor W-9 not applicable (they're Singapore entity) — need local invoice + VAT details. I'll prepare paperwork once PO finalized.

sanjay: Thanks all. Evan, ping here once the quota ticket is filed. Karen, I'll DM the PO + cost center docs. Tentative plan: if quota bump not approved in 7 days, fall back to Dedicated + spot mix. Any other blockers?

mira: Can someone ping @alex-cloud about expedited quota? He's the partner contact with GCP APAC team.

evans: Ticket created: TICKET-1345 (GCP quota increase request). ETA from GCP into tickets usually 48-72h but I'll follow up via partner channel. Linking vendor contact: atlas-support@vendor.atlas

sanjay: Perfect — keeping this thread as single source. Will update with PO number once confirmed. :spiral_calendar_pad:
